error_codes_chosen.EFF_UNKNOWN_MODE: effect has a schema, key registered, value NOT registered
error_codes_chosen.EFF_UNKNOWN_PARAM_KEY: effect has a schema, key NOT registered
error_codes_chosen.EFF_PARAMS_NOT_SUPPORTED: effect has NO schema but an explicit param was supplied (names tracking doc m-effect-clock-net-fs-modes)
error_codes_chosen.rationale: Doc deferred to planner 'following conventions in internal/pipeline/validate_effects.go' but that file has NO error codes (prose only). PAR_EFF0NN is a parser namespace, semantically wrong for an elaboration-phase rejection. Chose the EFF_ codes the design doc's own Examples section uses. MUST be embedded verbatim in the returned error text so footgun harness strings.Contains + ailang check both see them.

discrepancies_found.title: stringSliceToEffectRow bridge cannot carry an illegal param; doc over-scopes it
discrepancies_found.finding: Design doc Conflict Surface + Risks table mandate validation 'cover the stringSliceToEffectRow bridge path'. Live read of validate_effects.go:191-208 shows this bridge builds rows from effect NAME strings only (ast.EffectNames -> labels; Params field always nil). Params never flow through this bridge, so it can never present an illegal param to validate. The ONLY param-carrying elaboration path is ElaborateEffectRowWithBudgets (effects.go:225, captures eff.Params at :264-270).
discrepancies_found.action: Place validation in ElaborateEffectRowWithBudgets (true chokepoint). Cover the bridge with a cheap REGRESSION test proving nil-params round-trip triggers no validation (satisfies doc Conflict-Surface item 4 iface-cache back-compat) WITHOUT adding validation logic to the bridge. Scope reduction, not a gap.

discrepancies_found.title: Error codes are planner's call; PAR_EFF0NN is a parser namespace, unusable at elaboration
discrepancies_found.finding: Doc defers code naming to planner 'following conventions in internal/pipeline/validate_effects.go' but that file emits prose errors with NO codes (formatEffectError: 'Effect checking failed for function...'). The real code convention is the parser PAR_EFF0NN_* family (parser_effect.go) which is a PARSE-phase namespace, semantically wrong for a type/elaboration-phase rejection.
discrepancies_found.action: Use EFF_UNKNOWN_MODE / EFF_UNKNOWN_PARAM_KEY / EFF_PARAMS_NOT_SUPPORTED (already used in the design doc's Examples section): outside PAR_ parse namespace, greppable, stable for AI repair loops. Embed verbatim in error text.
